name: Afghanistan (Emirate, 1901–1919)
description: A black field with a white emblem in the centre: a mosque with mihrab and minbar between crossed weapons and flags, within a wreath.
history: State flag and royal banner introduced around 1901 when Habibullah Khan succeeded his father Abdur Rahman: the black field kept, with a white seal showing a mosque, the first appearance of the mosque emblem that has featured on almost every Afghan flag since. It was replaced in 1919 after Habibullah's assassination and the accession of Amanullah Khan.
